summary: Flowserve Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $500M 5.700% Senior Notes due 2036 to fund the purchase price for the Trillium Flow Acquisition. The offering is at 99.864% of par, with underwriting discounts of 0.650%, netting $496.07M proceeds. The notes have a special mandatory redemption at 101% if the acquisition is not closed by February 4, 2027. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The notes are unsecured and rank equally with other unsubordinated debt. Watch for regulatory or completion risks; the special redemption feature adds a risk-arb element if the deal falters.
